findings.issue: Source enforces the frozen directory by resolving to an absolute path with trailing slash so sibling prefixes do not match; the Skill's 'allowed files' has no path-normalization rule.
findings.recommendation: Require allowed paths recorded as normalized absolute prefixes with trailing separator.

lost_source_techniques: absolute path plus trailing slash to avoid prefix collision

findings.issue: Source defines a weighted, tool-backed rubric (type check 22%, lint 18%, tests 28%, dead code 13%, ...) with thresholds per score band and a dashboard; the Skill reduces this to qualitative 'signals'. Its gate also says 'aggregate scores alone do not justify remediation', which is fine, but no score is produced at all, so trend comparison is impossible.
findings.recommendation: Produce the weighted category score from deterministic tool exits as one output, alongside cited findings.

findings.issue: Phase 9 mutation needs a behavioral challenge; the current case set cannot detect removal of the leave-unchanged rule.

findings.issue: The source's concrete self-review questions (completeness vs spec, YAGNI, naming by intent, tests verify behavior not mocks) and the four-state report (DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, BLOCKED, NEEDS_CONTEXT) are replaced by a generic category list.

findings.issue: Non-Responsibilities references `pull-request-update`, which does not exist; the correct target is `remote-pull-request-change`.
Source auto-resolves only trivially mechanical conflicts (VERSION, CHANGELOG ordering) and stops otherwise; the Skill stops on any conflict, which is safer but loses the classification.
findings.recommendation: Keep stop-on-conflict but report whether each conflict is mechanical or semantic.

findings.recommendation: Map these statuses to transitions and add a no-parallel-writer invariant.
